attempt_policy: Exclusive output directory; preserve any partial trace and errors. Deterministic read-only verification may recompute the same static arithmetic without writing artifacts.
availability: Only initial eligibility and edge-consumption budget may prove a horizon unavailable. Other positive-horizon reachability remains unestablished. Never project an impossible negative edge count as an observed state.
checks: kernel count and worst-case match bounds
R02 observer node and degree-null edge domains
G2 local exposure domain separately from exact-horizon domain
sufficient exact-frontier bound from products of possible ordered match counts
initial motif completeness and sufficient all-snapshot coverage bound
pure arithmetic work bounds, not runtime or throughput
common_horizon: Report the greatest reviewed horizon for which every not-provably-unavailable cell has the respective domain guarantee; retain all unavailable cells in counts. This is not a campaign or new scientific gate.
independent_check: Ordered-multiset grammar enumeration versus nondecreasing ordered arc products; closed-form size projections versus incremental count-only arithmetic profiles. Neither code evolves a graph or consumes a match.
next_boundary: If the 50-event gate lacks full-panel measurement support, register a separate long-horizon measurement design/calibration; do not launch a short atlas or select a favorable subgrammar as repair.
rules: all 969 G2-path-v1 RHS multisets in R05a order; no subset selection
scope: Read only protocols and public receipts; no trajectories, native runs, holdout reads, candidate statistics, motif-ranking or rule selection
seeds: all five core plus all nine extra seeds from protocols/r05b.json, in stored order; each seed ID distinct
size_model: V(t)=V0+f*t; E(t)=E0+(k-2)*t conditional on successful events; retain isolates; peak sizes over every index 0..h
statistical_design: No replicate counts, parent registry, target/sham assay, power/test family or resampling plan is introduced. No operational eligibility or scientific acceptance is inferred.
